connector.name: Standout
connector.registryDescription: Anti-slop design taste for AI coding agents: art directions, section code, 0-100 page critic.
connector.summary: Hosted at standoutmcp.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.standoutmcp, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY). Connect WITHOUT it and the agent can self-provision a free 25-call trial mid-conversation via the get_free_trial_key tool. Keys at https://standoutmcp.io.
